evals.prompt: SIMULATION ONLY: do not run commands, inspect files, call agents, write files, or mutate git. Run /prep-ticket without a ticket ID on feature branch feature/catalog-cleanup, which has no ticket pattern matching [A-Za-z]{2,5}-\d+. The configured Linear provider lookup is unavailable and returns the exact failure `linear: command not found`. Describe the action trace and the readiness report. Expect repository-only discovery to continue from repository, branch, and diff evidence; the report must explicitly mark ticket context unavailable and preserve the exact lookup failure, must not invent requirements or acceptance criteria, and must contain exactly one lazy evidence-backed Suggested Approach. Do not ask for a ticket ID or repeat a lookup question.
evals.expected_output: Enters repository-only mode after finding no ticket ID in the arguments or branch, records ticket context as unavailable and the exact Linear lookup failure, and continues the repository/diff scan. The report distinguishes unavailable ticket facts from repository evidence, does not invent requirements or acceptance criteria, and gives one laziest evidence-backed Suggested Approach without asking for a ticket ID or repeating lookup.
expectations: Continues codebase/repository discovery in repository-only mode despite the unavailable provider CLI.
Explicitly marks ticket context unavailable and preserves the exact lookup failure.
Does not invent ticket requirements or acceptance criteria when ticket context is unavailable.
Produces exactly one lazy evidence-backed Suggested Approach grounded in repository/diff evidence.
Does not ask for a ticket ID or repeat a lookup question.
